==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. A leviathan tentacle bursts through the ground. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The leviathan was trying to eat the golden trees that grow in the caverns beneath the village, but the guardians of the trees killed it.)
Toxic waste irradiates it and it begins to spawn hostile Were-Squids. (When the leviathan tentacle burst from beneath the ground it hit the radioactive waste in the sewer that is used by the mutant elves that live in the sewer as their power source.) (Were-Squids resemble inky black humanoids with heads that resemble octopi.)
Johnson uses Were-Fish speech to convince the Were-Squids to work with us instead of fighting us. (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.)
